sharedGuard.confirmationPolicy: false for pricing, same guarded persistence and exact native action replay

problem: Header back swallowed an owned save error then navigated unconditionally.
Native back/swipe removed the route without persisting typed pricing or neighborhoods.
Old async callbacks had no mounted/SDK actor/occurrence/input revision checks before navigation.
fix: Header back now only produces the native action; the shared public usePreventRemove guard saves before replaying the exact captured object through the root ref. No Quitter confirmation is added to pricing.

Persistence is bound to the same local draft ID and freshly captured actor, SDK source, auth generation, focus and input revision. A failed write keeps the route and inputs; a fresh retry is required.
Later price edits, actor replacement, batched A-B-A, blur and unmount reject the old navigation and suppress stale alerts.
Draft initialization is awaited; an unsuccessful step marker does not poison a later explicit save of the already-read draft. An unknown or replaced draft is never silently adopted.
Continue still saves before preview and preserves saved photos, details, AI and uploaded order in its resume parameters.

intermediateInitialStepMarkerRegression.purpose: One selected regression exposed poisoned readiness; final full targeted run includes it with no skipped cases.

limits: RNTL uses the repository iOS preset; native picker/navigation/filesystem presentation remains a substituted transport. This is not a physical-device result.
The real pricing route, auth store, draft service, AsyncStorage adapter and installed SDK guard/reducer/removal traversal execute in the tests.
No automatic 500 ms autosave is claimed; every owned removal and Continue flush current pricing explicitly.
No server/Auth authority, namespace, API payload, analytics configuration, payment or shipping feature flag was changed.
No production deployment, data mutation, UI gesture, store upload or Git action was performed.
